title: Inspect and extend: Why unsigned bytes must not be broadcast
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/wallet-core.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve unsignedtransaction type, signing gap, refusal path, and no-send regression test.
problem: A payment plan is an unsigned instruction sheet, not a valid signed transaction. Trace the UI flow to broadcast and confirm the Electrum adapter throws before sending anything because signing and raw serialization are missing. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/wallet-core.ts` and the related project files: src/wallet-core.ts; src/walletContext.tsx; test/wallet.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to unsignedtransaction type, signing gap, refusal path, and no-send regression test.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Key management, signing, raw serialization, Lightning, and production broadcast are not implemented.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A payment plan is an unsigned instruction sheet, not a valid signed transaction. Trace the UI flow to broadcast and confirm the Electrum adapter throws before sending anything because signing and raw serialization are missing.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/wallet-core.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
